name: xflickr_quota_near_limit

query_condition.sql: SELECT key_id FROM "{{OPENOBSERVE_STREAM}}" WHERE event='crawl.health.key' AND "limit" > 0 AND used >= 0.9 * "limit" GROUP BY key_id

description: Impact: A Flickr API key is above 90 percent of its hourly quota of granted calls. Action: Check usage and prepare for throttling or key rotation.
